# AI-DLC intent

## Intent

Describe the problem, expected outcome, and why it matters.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe the observable outcome or investigation deliverable.

## Constraints

Record relevant scope boundaries, non-goals, and security or compatibility constraints.

## References

Link relevant specifications, issues, or evidence. Record design decisions and lifecycle checkpoints in comments; do not duplicate the specification.
